merchant/31305.htm.text: Trader Kendis: Some people underestimate the importance of accessories by considering them only decorative, but that's not the case at all. I'm sure that an experienced adventurer like you knows their true worth.

links.text: Ask about the local lord and tax rate

merchant/31305-pk.htm.text: Trader Candice: I heard that in Rune, all criminals are hung! Isn't that horrible? It could happen to you!
